verdict.rationale: Cline documents headless autonomous runs inside GitHub Actions, GitLab, or any pipeline. In those runs it can modify files, run commands, and run and fix tests, and its Kanban board gives you diffs to review. However, the remote execution comes from CI pipelines Cline runs inside, not from a first-party hosted cloud agent, and nothing shows the agent producing a demo of the finished feature. missing for 10: a first-party managed cloud agent environment, a demo artifact (screenshots, video, or preview deploy) handed back for review, a documented end-to-end build-test-demo workflow, and independent hands-on corroboration of remote runs.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have a cloud agent build, test, and demo a feature end-to-end for my review

citations.quote: Run it headlessly inside GitHub Actions, GitLab, or any pipeline.
Autonomous execution can modify files and run commands without further prompts.
cline --auto-approve true "run tests and fix failures"
Review diffs in card detail view and leave inline comments.
